en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate historic theater building in a Central European city. The structure is richly decorated in a neo-baroque style with arches, columns, balconies, sculptures, and elaborate façade ornamentation. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk and stand in front of the theater. At the top of the postcard, printed in orange letters, are the words indicating the place and the building.
